epics.title: User Account and Access Permissions Configuration Dashboard
epics.jtbd: When an Administrator needs to register new teachers or students or adjust their roles, I want an administrative dashboard to manage users and configure permissions, so that access control policies are accurately enforced.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce overall permission configuration errors from 10 to 0
requirements: R1: Administrator can view, create, update, or revoke user accounts and assign roles such as Teacher, Student, or Content-manager

slices.title: Patch access permissions configuration backend logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing user management logic for this epic, I want to patch the existing backend services, so that access control policies are accurately enforced.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an Administrator accesses user management,
When they update roles,
Then the changes are correctly enforced in the backend.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce backend logic permission errors from 10 to 0

slices.title: QA for Access Permissions Configuration
slices.jtbd: When implementing user management logic for this epic, I want to verify the patched functionality across the test pyramid, so that access control policies are accurately enforced.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an Administrator accesses user management,
When they update roles,
Then tests confirm the changes are correctly enforced in the backend.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unverified access control scenarios from 10 to 0

epics.title: Document Version Restoration Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When an incorrect or corrupt document version is published, I want to rollback or restore the document to a previously archived version, so that users do not download invalid or outdated guidelines.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce overall time to restore correct document version from 15 mins to 1 min
requirements: R1: Administrator can trigger a version restore command to mark an archived version as active and archive the previously active version

slices.title: Patch document version restoration logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing version restoration for this epic, I want to patch the existing versioning logic, so that users do not download invalid or outdated guidelines.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a document has archived versions,
When an Administrator restores a version,
Then the target version becomes active and the old one is archived.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce backend version transition time from 15 mins to 1 min

slices.title: QA for Document Version Restoration
slices.jtbd: When implementing version restoration for this epic, I want to verify the restore command across the test pyramid, so that users do not download invalid or outdated guidelines.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a document has archived versions,
When an Administrator restores a version,
Then tests confirm the target version becomes active and the old one is archived.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unverified version restoration scenarios from 15 to 0
